### 4.4 The Opus screen tracks Pangram

A blinded LLM screen over the full corpus (37,801 segments, date-blind) separates Pangram's classes cleanly on the 618-segment overlap; the remainder of the section reports an effort-level A/B test and token-cost comparison.
proposed: Split before “**Reasoning effort buys nothing here, and that is worth stating rather than hiding.**” Keep the detector-agreement result in §4.4 and move the effort A/B test, its table, and its supporting footnote to Appendix D after §D.2.
rationale: The AUC result validates the screen and belongs in Results; the low-versus-max effort experiment is implementation validation. Moving it to reproducibility material shortens the results arc without losing any datum.
